items.t: First Solar CEO Urges Bipartisan Support for Industrial Strategy, Enforcement of US Trade and Tax Policy at House Select Committee on China Hearing
items.sum: WASHINGTON, November 20, 2026--Mark Widmar, chief executive officer of First Solar, Inc. (Nasdaq: FSLR) ("First Solar" or "the Company"), today urged bipartisan support for an industrial strategy and the enforcement of American trade and tax laws to sustain domestic manufacturing growth.
